prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2025-11-06, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2025-11-06):
| Current ratio           | 1.32 |
| Retained earnings       | 68,459M |
| Current liabilities     | 12,009M |
| Current assets          | 15,884M |
| Shareholders' equity    | 64,923M |
| Total liabilities       | 57,549M |
| Total assets            | 122,472M |
| EBIT / operating income | 2,702M |
| Revenue                 | 14,969M |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The company shows solid capitalization with equity of 64.9B against liabilities of 57.5B, yielding a comfortable net asset base. Liquidity is reasonable (current ratio 1.32) and operating profitability is strong (EBIT 2.7B on revenue 15.0B, ~18% margin), suggesting adequate cash generation. However, limited visibility into long-term debt structure and interest coverage leaves some downside headroom, placing the issuer at the lower end of investment-grade.

DECISION: BBB+
